name: Rhythm — Raindrops
summary: Vary the time between motions unpredictably—short gaps, long gaps, light taps, and lingering touches—so the clitoris cannot anticipate the next beat and stimulation stays fresh.
detailed_description: Raindrops uses irregular timing rather than a steady beat. Intervals might be half a second or two seconds; some contacts are brief and light, others longer and deeper. The unpredictability maintains suspense and reduces habituation. If a partner needs more predictability, repeat each variation a fixed number of times before changing so the irregularity becomes a learnable phrase.
stepwise_structure: 1. Start with a motion that already feels good.
2. Vary pause length between strokes—unpredictably, not on a fixed count.
3. Mix brief light touches with occasional longer, lingering contacts.
4. Avoid falling into an accidental steady beat; refresh the randomness if sensation plateaus.
5. If irregularity feels chaotic to the receiver, structure repeats (e.g. same gap sequence three times) before introducing a new variation.
safety_notes: Some people strongly prefer consistent rhythm; confirm raindrops-style play is welcome.
Sudden long pauses after intense contact can feel jarring—balance with feedback.

meta.pattern_character: irregular intervals and varied touch duration
